title: Signed third autocorrelation constant C_1d, upper bound
statement: A step function f with n equal cells on [-1/4, 1/4] (signed values v) gives C_1d <= 2n max_m |c_m| / S^2 with c = v * v and S = sum v. Find v making this smaller.
submission: JSON {"values": [...]}: the cell values (integers, binary64 numbers, or exact decimal strings).

provenance.keeper: T. Tao et al., optimization constants repository (teorth/optimizationproblems)

score: a certified upper bound on the constant (exact; smaller is better)
